437.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Dead Fields
english.detail:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
english.objective:
Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.

When Nightlash appears, kill her.

Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Have you defeated Nightlash, <name>?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
english.complete:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, <name>, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day.  Your value to the Forsaken grows.

8: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
When Nightlash appears, kill her.
Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

437.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

438.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Decrepit Ferry
english.detail:
<name>, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
english.objective:
Go to the Decrepit Ferry.

Search for the reason the Scourge are there.
english.complete:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.

8: Go to the Decrepit Ferry.
Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

438.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

439.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Rot Hide Clues
english.detail:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
english.objective: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: <name>.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
english.complete:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!

8: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

439.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

443.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Rot Hide Ichor
english.detail:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
english.objective: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Do you have the rot hide ichor, <name>?
english.complete:
Very good.  This ichor will help us understand the nature of the rot hides, and may show us their weakness...

...if they have one.

8: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

443.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

444.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Rot Hide Origins
english.detail:
I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components.  My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.  Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

Go.  You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
english.objective: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
english.progress: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
english.complete:
This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...

One moment -- I must invoke a spell of divination...

8: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

444.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

446.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Thule Ravenclaw
english.detail:
This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw.  He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.

I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!

I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them.  Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel.  It has the incantations needed for the potion.
english.objective: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.
english.progress: Greetings, <name>.  What did Bethor have to say?
english.complete: This scroll is laced with powerful magic.  I've never used such forces in a potion ... it will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.

8: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.

446.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

448.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Report to Hadrec
english.detail: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec.  He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
english.objective: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.complete:
If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.

To aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...

8: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

448.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

477.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Border Crossings
english.detail:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
english.objective: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.
english.complete:
<Prying open the lid of the crate, you find an assortment of carefully-packed objects. On the top of the crate lies a bundle of maps, yellowing with age, that appear to depict Silverpine Forest and other parts of western Lordaeron.

Underneath the maps is a mysterious-looking magical pendant.>

8: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.

477.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

478.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Maps and Runes
english.detail: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
english.objective: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Have you learned anything useful, <name>?
english.complete:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.

8: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

478.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

479.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Ambermill Investigations
english.detail:
Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.

Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
english.objective: Obtain 8 Dalaran Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: We must hurry, their plans must not come to fruition, or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.
english.complete:
Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.

A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.

8: Obtain 8 Dalaran Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

479.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

481.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Dalar's Analysis
english.detail: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
english.objective: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Yes, <class>? What is it?
english.complete:
Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.

8: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

481.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

482.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Dalaran's Intentions
english.detail:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
english.objective: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.complete:
Ill news you bring, <name>. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.

8: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

482.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

447.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Recipe For Death
english.detail:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
english.objective: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
english.progress: Hail, <class>.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
english.complete: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, <name>.  These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause.  I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.

8: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

447.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

450.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Recipe For Death
english.detail:
You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, <name>.

When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard.  Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us.  But his findings might prove to be of worth.  He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
english.objective: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: I see you are back, <name>.
english.complete: Apothecary Berard's journal!  Why you are quite brave, <name>.  Now let's see what Berard was up to before he went mad. . .

8: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

450.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

451.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: A Recipe For Death
english.detail:
According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague.  Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.

He also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc.  Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.

Collect samples of the moss as well as the rare Hardened Tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
english.objective: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
english.progress: What brings you back to the Undercity, <name>?
english.complete:
Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard.  But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

We are on the cusp of something great here, <name>.  If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.

8: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

451.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

6321.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Supplying the Sepulcher
english.detail:
Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher.  With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.

I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.  Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.
english.objective: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.
english.progress: You appear to be on official business...
english.complete: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.

8: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

6321.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

6322.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Michael Garrett
english.detail:
I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.

Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
english.objective: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
english.progress: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
english.complete: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine?  That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.

8: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

6322.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

6323.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Ride to the Undercity
english.detail:
One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
english.objective: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
english.progress: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
english.complete: An order from the Sepulcher?  Very well.  It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.

8: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

6323.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

6324.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Return to Podrig
english.detail:
The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok.  If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.

Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.

You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there.  Speak with me again when you are ready.
english.objective: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
english.progress: <name>, you return.  Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
english.complete:
Good work, <name>.  These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.

You have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.

8: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

6324.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

435.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Escorting Erland
english.detail:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
english.objective: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.
english.progress: Please be brief.  There is much danger about and we cannot stand idle in conversation.
english.complete: Thank you for the aid, <name>.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.

8: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

435.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

449.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Deathstalkers' Report
english.detail: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
english.objective: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
english.complete:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, <name>.  And you will be commended.

8: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

449.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

440.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Engraved Ring
english.detail:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
english.objective: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
english.progress: Hello, <name>.  What brings you back to Brill?
english.complete:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago.  She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed.  I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.

8: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

440.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

441.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Raleigh and the Undercity
english.detail:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
english.objective: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.
english.progress: Do I know you?
english.complete:
Yes, this ring was my wife's.  Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times.  I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me.  But desire does still burn in my dead heart, <name>.

Desire for revenge.

8: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.

441.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

460.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: Resting in Pieces
english.detail:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
english.objective: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.
english.progress: This grave was hastily dug.
english.complete: Thank you, <name>.  I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body.  It is good to know they did not.

8: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.

460.questieMetadataNote: Installed 1.0.12 identity, objective and chain reviewed; database availability is not a live-client verification.

461.sourceKind: Wowhead Forever English reference; current live dialogue unverified

english.title: The Hidden Niche
english.detail:
I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues.  It also holds something you might find useful.  Take me there!

The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.

Take my body, but leave my boots.  They never fit me anyway...
english.objective: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.
english.progress: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
english.complete:
There we are, it's open.  Leave me here.  I spent the best days of my life in this keep, and the thought of resting within its walls gives me comfort.

Be sure to close the alcove tight - I don't want those Rot Hides to find me.

Oh, and take this.  You've earned it.

8: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.

96821.sourceKind: current Wowhead Forever English HTML; independently checked against current installed QuestieDB 1.0.12 metadata and available 60.tools English

english.title: Legging It
english.objective: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
english.complete: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, <name>. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
english.detail:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

8: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.

96825.sourceKind: current Wowhead Forever English HTML; independently checked against current installed QuestieDB 1.0.12 metadata and available 60.tools English

english.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
english.objective: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
english.progress: Did you find the fruits?
english.complete: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
english.detail:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!

8: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.

96822.sourceKind: current Wowhead Forever English HTML; independently checked against current installed QuestieDB 1.0.12 metadata and available 60.tools English

english.title: For Honor
english.objective: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked?
english.complete: These warriors will always be remembered, <name>. You have made sure of that.
english.detail:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.

8: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.

96873.sourceKind: current Wowhead Forever English HTML; independently checked against current installed QuestieDB 1.0.12 metadata and available 60.tools English

english.title: A Pain in the Neck
english.objective: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
english.progress: What do you have for me, <name>?
english.complete: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
english.detail:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!

8: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Ukor's Lost Pack
english.objective: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
english.progress: Something need doing?
english.complete: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
english.detail: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.

8: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.

english.title: Lost in the Shadows
english.objective: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
english.complete:
Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?

Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
english.detail:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.

8: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
9: Escort Pal'juh out of Kolkar Crag.

english.title: Forgotten Loa Idols
english.objective: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
english.progress: Have you found our loa idols, <name>? We must begin our rituals again soon.
english.complete:
You have done a great deed for our tribe today.

Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.

I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
english.detail:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.

8: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

english.title: This Is Spinal Axe
english.objective: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete: These spines are tougher than I expected, <name>! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... but I'll keep working on it!
english.detail:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.

8: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.

english.title: The Hermit Tanner
english.objective: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
english.progress: Greetings, <class>. What brings you up to my property today?
english.complete: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
english.detail:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

8: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.

english.title: Unwelcome Guests
english.objective: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
english.complete:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, <class>.
english.detail:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

8: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.

english.title: Trouble in the Valley
english.objective: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
english.progress:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
english.complete: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
english.detail:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

8: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.

english.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg
english.detail:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
english.objective: Shayla Nightbreeze on the road outside of Darnassus wants you to bring her 15 Gnarlpine Fangs.
english.progress: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
english.complete: You have served well, <name>. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.

8: Shayla Nightbreeze on the road outside of Darnassus wants you to bring her 15 Gnarlpine Fangs.

english.title: Soft Saber Pelts
english.detail:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
english.objective: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
english.progress: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
english.complete:
Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.

Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.

8: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.

english.title: An Enchanting Lesson
english.detail:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
english.objective:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
english.progress: What have your studies revealed?
english.complete: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, <name>. Remember this.

8: Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.
Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.

english.detail:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
english.objective: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.
english.progress: You look troubled. I am listening.
english.complete:
<Thundris does not speak for some time.>

This bears the mark of an ancient evil, <class>. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.

Ande'thoras-ethil.

8: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.

english.title: Crown of the Earth
english.detail:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, <class>. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
english.objective: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
english.progress: How may I aid you?
english.complete:
Do not mind the Arch Druid, <name>. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.

Wait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?

8: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

english.title: Crown of the Earth
english.detail:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
english.objective: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
english.progress: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
english.complete:
Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.

<Tyrande's face settles.>

I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.

Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.

Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.

8: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

english.title: Twisted Hatred
english.detail:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
english.objective: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
english.progress:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
english.complete:
I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.

I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.

Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we keep this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.

I trust you to do the same.

8: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.

english.title: Twisted Hatred
english.objective: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
english.detail:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.

english.title: Twisted Hatred
english.objective: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
english.progress:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
english.complete:
I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.

I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.

Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we keep this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.

I trust you to do the same.

english.title: Escaping Ban'ethil
english.detail:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
english.objective: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
english.complete:
Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.

Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.

english.progress: Not bad, mate... not bad at all.
english.complete:
Incredible! What skill!

Thought you'd be easy prey, <name>. Got me good, you did.

Here's the coin I promised... not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.
english.detail:
What?

What?!

You want money? I don't owe you any money.

Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
